answer: Each agent stakes an atlas-bound bond, and every epoch its raven key must co-sign a unique liveness signal tied to fresh hardware attestation. Duplicate identities collapse because cloning the raven key without the bonded stake yields no attestable signal, and forging one costs the full bond plus slashing of prior rewards. An attacker must therefore burn real capital per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Operator Agent0109 applies this at r3JXvK6UY3.
